experiments.goal: Validate semantic identity before trusting novelty or dedupe.
experiments.hypothesis: Sorted token sets may erase causal direction, temporal order, multiplicity and entity roles; IDs may falsely merge distinct mechanisms.
experiments.probe: Call existing exports with paired mechanisms: A funds B vs B funds A; verify before delivery vs verify after delivery; payer refunds seller vs seller refunds payer. Also include genuine paraphrases. Keep original provenance and role bindings.
experiments.acceptance: Directionally distinct relations must remain distinguishable; equivalent phrasing should dedupe where equivalence is justified. Unknown equivalence remains unresolved. If failure reproduced, propose smallest typed relation/ordering fix at existing seam; do not call a sorted-word hash a causal model.
experiments.kill: If canonical mechanism identity already preserves each tested distinction through another layer, record verified reuse and close without code.
experiments.budget: One focused harness, no model calls required.

experiments.goal: Make experiment feasibility an enforceable contract.
experiments.hypothesis: Selected probe cost/time may exceed top-level ceilings, and caller-declared discriminating=true is not evidence of actual discrimination.
experiments.probe: Zero ceiling with positive-cost probe; probe time above ceiling; malformed effect counts; a probe giving identical observations under rival hypotheses. Separate syntactic checks from semantic discrimination.
experiments.acceptance: Over-budget or malformed plans refuse rather than silently normalize to safe. The chosen probe's declared effects bind its authority check. A discrimination declaration is labelled unverified until a concrete predicted outcome difference is shown. Execution permission cannot arise from descriptive prose.
experiments.kill: If downstream admission already enforces exact probe limits and effect identity, exercise that path and reuse it; avoid duplicate permission layers.
experiments.budget: One focused fake-only harness; real probes require separate applicable authority.

experiments.goal: Prove cross-domain learning rather than a larger feature catalog.
experiments.source: Existing GENESIS, Wallbreaker and Capability Genome; resolve and claim exact seams before editing.
experiments.hypothesis: A reusable mechanism distilled from one observed failure can improve held-out tasks in different domains without more compute.
experiments.probe: Freeze a development set and evaluator-held-out task families spanning software recovery, evidence reconciliation, resource planning and causal reasoning. Compare identical base model/tools with: no new mechanism, existing mechanism, candidate mechanism. Hold tokens/tool budgets constant; log route and actual cost.
experiments.acceptance: Predeclare task-level success and meaningful improvement threshold before candidate sees holdouts. Report each family's paired outcomes and uncertainty, cost, latency, abstentions and regressions. A small smoke panel is feasibility only. No generality claim from one family or a synthetic aggregate.
experiments.kill: Stop if gain disappears against the unchanged-model control or when extra compute is removed; preserve null results.
experiments.budget: Cheap model on development cases first; one candidate at a time; no frontier-model tournament by default.

experiments.source: Existing evaluator/adversary and forecast provenance paths; src/forecast-adversarial-ensemble.mjs is a donor to inspect.
experiments.hypothesis: Generator/evaluator shared ancestry or repeated holdout reuse can manufacture apparent improvement.
experiments.probe: Keep holdout answers outside generator context and editable worktree; track exposure and dataset versions. Test correlated copies, misleading high-confidence answers and evaluator blind spots. Reused holdout becomes development data.
experiments.acceptance: Candidate cannot edit its acceptance standard or promote itself. Duplicated upstream evidence does not count as independent support. Independent executable checks outrank another model vote; unavailable isolation is explicitly EVALUATION_LIMITED.
experiments.kill: Do not build model councils unless they find incremental independently verified errors within the same budget.
experiments.budget: Deterministic checks first; different model label alone is not independence.

experiments.goal: Improve tool use and reasoning without eroding earlier capability.
experiments.source: Existing capability admission/promotion/revocation; no new self-modification bypass.
experiments.hypothesis: A promoted reusable skill can retain its benefit after a context reset and preserve earlier tasks.
experiments.probe: Save the minimum mechanism plus applicability conditions, counterexamples, provenance and rollback pointer. Rehydrate in a fresh authorized session with a cheaper worker; run held-out transfer and old-task regression panels. Revoke the candidate and prove selection stops.
experiments.acceptance: Replayable improvement receipt bound to model/tool/code revisions and evaluation version; no old-task harm beyond predeclared tolerance; sensitive authority gates have zero tolerated regression. Unproven memory remains a hypothesis. No autonomous production promotion.
experiments.kill: Reject if benefit depends on hidden chat context, evaluator leakage, relaxed gates or forgotten prior capabilities.
experiments.budget: One fresh-context replay, one regression panel; broader run only to resolve a concrete remaining risk.

experiments.goal: Allocate reasoning to the next useful observation, not repeated internal discussion.
experiments.source: Existing bounded experiments, forecast decision boundary and calibration ledger.
experiments.hypothesis: An uncertainty-aware action/observe/defer policy reduces real cost per correct bounded decision.
experiments.probe: Under fixed budget compare answer-now, one discriminating observation, and defer. Preserve prediction before observation; use authorized non-sensitive cases with objectively scoreable outcomes. Separate value of information from verbal confidence.
experiments.acceptance: Report decision quality and cost at matched coverage; count abstentions and missed useful actions. Observation only selected when it can change a decision and fits authority/budget. Small-sample outcomes do not certify real-world life benefits.
experiments.kill: Stop if additional reasoning/observation cannot beat the cheap baseline after its cost, or if no discriminating lawful observation exists.
experiments.budget: No new paid commitment; no customer, financial or private-life experiment inferred from this plan.
